supersession_law.record_level: Corrections create new records plus supersession status events; prior truth is never overwritten; superseded records retain lineage (ADR-008).
supersession_law.decision_level: Superseding choices create a new ADR rather than rewriting an accepted one (docs/adr/README.md); legacy surfaces retire through documented aliases and migrations (ADR-023, ADR-058).

decisions.title: Provider role reclassification: canonical-like transport becomes rebuildable projection
decisions.superseded_behavior: v0.2 lineage treated the graph provider as a de facto system of record
decisions.superseding_behavior: RecordStore is the sole canonical owner; Graphiti/Zep are deletable, rebuildable projections behind a durable outbox
decisions.residual_risk: Live provider lifecycle proof external (RP-004, RP-005)

decisions.title: Graphiti tool dialect supersession: add_episode/search_facts superseded by add_memory/search_memory_facts
decisions.superseded_behavior: Legacy Graphiti MCP tool names add_episode and search_facts as the only dialect
decisions.superseding_behavior: Transport negotiates per server, preferring add_memory and search_memory_facts while retaining legacy dialect support
decisions.residual_risk: None locally; dialect behavior against heterogeneous live servers folds into RP-004

decisions.title: Search failure semantics: empty-result masking superseded by typed per-strategy receipts
decisions.superseded_behavior: Failed backend searches could be represented as zero results
decisions.superseding_behavior: Typed complete/partial/failed retrieval receipts record every attempted, succeeded, and failed strategy
decisions.residual_risk: Downstream callers must adopt receipt inspection; documented in MIGRATION.md

decisions.title: Namespace authority supersession: caller-asserted namespaces superseded by server-derived claim intersection
decisions.superseded_behavior: v0.2 accepted arbitrary remote namespaces from callers
decisions.superseding_behavior: Requested namespaces are intersected with server-derived MemoryPrincipal claims before any read or write
decisions.residual_risk: Remote callers require explicit claims; migration path in MIGRATION.md

decisions.title: Deletion semantics supersession: undefined destructive deletion superseded by redacted tombstone plus verified projection erasure
decisions.superseded_behavior: Deletion lacked a verified contract across canonical state and projections
decisions.superseding_behavior: Immediate canonical redaction to a tombstone preserving referential integrity; deletion receipt completes only after locator-verified projection erasure (Graphiti delete_episode, Zep graph.episode.delete)
decisions.residual_risk: Live erasure confirmation against hosted providers folds into RP-004 and RP-005; guard state path migration retains legacy read

closure.statement: Every legacy concept from the eight harvest source packs is dispositioned as implemented, rejected_boundary, or blocked_external; the five REV decisions consolidate that ledger at review level and mirror supersession-map.md entry for entry.
